question: A, B, and C started a business. A invested Rs. 1,20,000, B invested Rs. 80,000, and C invested Rs. 1,00,000. After 6 months, A added Rs. 20,000, and C withdrew Rs. 10,000. If the total profit at the end of 2 years is Rs. 3,60,000, how much will A receive?
solution:
**Given:**

Investments:

A = ₹1,20,000

B = ₹80,000

C = ₹1,00,000

Changes after 6 months:

A adds ₹20,000 ⇒ New investment = ₹1,40,000

C withdraws ₹10,000 ⇒ New investment = ₹90,000

Time period: 24 months

Total profit = ₹3,60,000

**Formula used:**

Profit distribution is based on investment × time:

Share of Profit = (Investment × Time) ÷ (Sum of all Investments × Time) × Total Profit
